tests.title: Notifications store rejects locally when encrypted discovery is unavailable
tests.description: Verifies the store refuses to publish when encrypted request discovery does not advertise a service pubkey plus encrypted request relays.
preconditions: Notifications store is loaded under Vitest.
`encryptedRequestsAvailable()` mock returns false.
steps: Call `listNotificationChannels()`.
Observe thrown error, publish mock calls, and store error state.
tests.expected_result: The call rejects with the availability error, `requestEncryptedResult` is never called, and `notificationState.channelsError` is populated.
data_requirements: Deterministic Nostr discovery object without encrypted capability indicators.

tests.title: Encrypted relay discovery ignores public browser relays
tests.description: Confirms encrypted relay resolution stays on `browser_relays` and does not become available from relay URLs alone without the encrypted feature gate and service pubkey.
preconditions: Encrypted controlplane module is loaded under Vitest.
steps: Call `encryptedRelayUrlsFromSystemInfo()` with only `browser_relays` set.
Call `encryptedRequestsAvailable()` with the same input.
tests.expected_result: Resolved encrypted relay list is empty and encrypted request availability is false.
data_requirements: Deterministic Nostr discovery containing `service_pubkey` and only `browser_relays`.

tests.title: Encrypted notification request event uses canonical kind, recipient, and routing marker
tests.description: Builds an encrypted request event and verifies gift-wrapped outer kind `1059`, service pubkey targeting, inner ContextVM kind `25910`, encrypted wire tag, and ciphertext payload construction.
preconditions: Authenticated signer mocks are configured.
Encrypted relay list and service pubkey are available.
steps: Construct an `EncryptedControlplaneTransport`.
Build an encrypted request event for a sample operation.
Inspect the signed event passed to `signWithAuth`.
tests.expected_result: The outer event is kind `1059` and tagged with `['p', service_pubkey]`; the inner signed ContextVM event is kind `25910`, carries `['encrypted', 'contextvm-jsonrpc-v1']`, and the wrapper contains ciphertext rather than plaintext JSON.
data_requirements: Stable requester pubkey and service pubkey strings.
determinism_notes: Ciphertext is mocked as a string prefix; no real relay needed.

tests.title: Encrypted publish succeeds only with at least one accepted OK
tests.description: Exercises publish success and relay rejection handling in the encrypted transport client.
preconditions: Encrypted transport has one connected relay client mock.
steps: Publish an encrypted request event with `accepted=true`.
Repeat with `accepted=false` and a relay rejection message.
tests.expected_result: The first publish resolves successfully; the second rejects with the relay-provided reason.
determinism_notes: No live relay; OK responses are fully mocked.

tests.title: Encrypted result resolution requires correlation by request id, requester pubkey, and service author
tests.description: Validates that unrelated, spoofed, and duplicate result events do not resolve the request and that the correlated event does.
preconditions: Encrypted result subscription is opened by the transport client.
steps: Emit unrelated result events with wrong `#e` and wrong author.
Emit one correctly correlated event.
Emit a duplicate correlated event.
tests.expected_result: Only the correctly correlated event resolves the request and the subscription is unsubscribed exactly once.
data_requirements: Stable requester pubkey, service pubkey, and request id.
determinism_notes: Events are injected directly through subscription callbacks.

tests.title: Notifications browser journey loads channel list over encrypted relays only
tests.description: Runs the browser flow against mocked public and encrypted relay URLs and asserts that notifications list loading uses gift-wrapped ContextVM kind `1059` on encrypted relays.
preconditions: Playwright harness provides deterministic Nostr discovery with both public and encrypted relay URLs.
Browser signer and nip44 mocks are installed.
steps: Open `/notifications`.
Observe initial table render and transport trace.
tests.expected_result: The notifications page renders the existing channel and all encrypted publishes are outer kind `1059` events targeting the encrypted relay URL, not the public relay URL.
data_requirements: Stable service pubkey and relay URLs.
determinism_notes: Relay responses are synthesized in-page; no external services are used.

tests.title: Notifications create and test actions remain on encrypted operations
tests.description: Covers create and test actions in the browser and inspects the encrypted operation trace.
preconditions: Playwright encrypted relay harness is installed.
Notifications list route is accessible to the mocked signer.
steps: Create a notification channel.
Trigger the test action.
Inspect recorded operations and publish relay URLs.
tests.expected_result: The trace includes `notifications.channels.create` and `notifications.channels.test`, the new row appears in the UI, success toasts render, and no publish targets a public relay.
fixtures: Deterministic initial channels and empty log list.
data_requirements: Stable created channel name and webhook URL.
determinism_notes: Harness mutates in-memory notification state only.

tests.title: Notification store mutation helpers upsert and delete channel state through encrypted operations
tests.description: Verifies create, update, test, and delete helper methods call the expected encrypted operation names and leave local channel state deterministic.
preconditions: Notifications store is reset before test execution.
steps: Mock sequential encrypted results for create, update, test, and delete.
Call each store method in order.
Inspect request payloads and final channel state.
tests.expected_result: Each method invokes the correct encrypted operation; delete removes the channel and update does not leave duplicate rows.
data_requirements: Stable channel id `ch-1` and update payload.

tests.title: Notification logs success path uses encrypted log operation and stores returned entries
tests.description: Confirms `listNotificationLogs()` uses `notifications.logs.list` and stores returned log entries.
preconditions: Notifications store is reset.
Encrypted requests are available.
steps: Mock a successful encrypted logs result.
Call `listNotificationLogs({ limit: 50 })`.
Inspect invoked operation and stored log state.
tests.expected_result: The store calls `notifications.logs.list` with the provided payload and populates `notificationState.logs` from the decrypted result.
data_requirements: Stable log fixture with private payload content.

tests.title: Notification logs failure path clears stale log entries and sets `logsError`
tests.description: Adds the missing negative-path coverage for encrypted log retrieval failure semantics required by the acceptance criteria.
preconditions: Store contains a pre-existing log entry from an earlier successful load.
Next encrypted logs request resolves with an error or rejects.
steps: Seed `notificationState.logs` through a successful call.
Invoke `listNotificationLogs()` again with an error result.
Inspect `notificationState.logs`, `logsLoading`, and `logsError`.
tests.expected_result: The stale log list is cleared, `logsLoading` becomes false, and `logsError` contains the terminal error.
data_requirements: One stable seed log entry and one stable terminal error payload.

tests.title: Backend publishes correlated encrypted terminal error for decrypt failures
tests.description: Verifies undecryptable encrypted requests yield a correlated terminal error result with `decrypt_failed`.
preconditions: Encrypted responder and publisher test harness are initialized.
steps: Deliver an invalid NIP-44 encrypted request event to the transport.
Inspect the published encrypted result envelope.
tests.expected_result: The backend publishes one encrypted result with status `error` and error code `decrypt_failed`.
fixtures: Deterministic service and requester private keys
data_requirements: Stable routing tags targeting the service pubkey.
determinism_notes: All cryptographic material is local test data.

tests.title: Backend rejects unauthorized encrypted requesters without invoking the domain handler
tests.description: Verifies unauthorized encrypted requests produce a correlated error and do not reach the registered handler.
preconditions: Encrypted request transport is configured with an allowlist that excludes the requester pubkey.
steps: Register a handler that would flip a boolean if invoked.
Deliver a decryptable request from an unauthorized pubkey.
Inspect handler invocation and published result.
tests.expected_result: The handler is never called and one encrypted result is published with error code `unauthorized`.

tests.title: Notification form preserves valid entered data after terminal encrypted submit failure
tests.description: Browser coverage proving failed encrypted create and update submissions keep valid entered data while surfacing a visible alert.
preconditions: Browser harness can return a terminal encrypted error for `notifications.channels.create` or `notifications.channels.update`.
steps: Open the notification create form and submit valid data while the encrypted create operation returns a terminal error.
Verify the create form retains the entered values and renders the error alert.
Open the edit form for an existing notification channel and submit valid changes while the encrypted update operation returns a terminal error.
Verify the edit form retains the changed values and renders the error alert.
tests.expected_result: Both create and edit routes render the error in `div.form-error[role=alert]` and preserve the current valid field values for retry.
fixtures: Encrypted relay harness variant that returns a terminal error result for form submission.
data_requirements: Stable channel name and webhook URL used for form entry.
determinism_notes: Should be implemented entirely with the existing in-page relay harness pattern.

tests.title: Notifications routes expose labelled controls, headings, and alert regions
tests.description: Extends the existing browser test or adds a dedicated accessibility-oriented browser test to assert labels and alert semantics beyond the current heading checks.
preconditions: Notifications routes are reachable under the Playwright harness.
steps: Open `/notifications` and `/notifications/new`.
Assert the expected headings.
Assert form controls are discoverable by accessible label.
Trigger a form error and assert an alert region is exposed.
tests.expected_result: The list and create routes expose the expected top-level headings, key inputs are label-addressable, and submission errors are available via an alert region.
fixtures: Same deterministic Nostr discovery and encrypted harness as the notifications smoke test.
data_requirements: Stable route copy for headings and labels.
determinism_notes: A browser accessibility assertion is preferable to a static component snapshot because the route copy and rendered structure matter.

tests.title: Backend propagates handler failures as correlated encrypted terminal errors
tests.description: Adds backend transport coverage proving an authorized notification handler error publishes a correlated gift-wrapped ContextVM encrypted terminal error with handler_failed instead of silently dropping or dispatching a public fallback.
preconditions: Encrypted request transport has an authorized requester and a registered notification operation handler that returns an error.
steps: Deliver a decryptable gift-wrapped ContextVM notification request (`1059` or `21059` around inner `25910`).
Have the registered handler return a deterministic error.
Decrypt and inspect the published gift-wrapped ContextVM result envelope.
tests.expected_result: One encrypted result is published with #e/#p correlation, status error, error.code handler_failed, and the terminal handler message.
fixtures: Deterministic service and requester private keys
mocks: Notification operation handler returning an error
data_requirements: Stable notifications.channels.create request envelope and handler error text.
determinism_notes: No relay or network dependency; event delivery is direct to HandleEvent.
